guarantees.title: Canonical market identity routing
guarantees.claim_summary: Collection and runtime routing resolve the canonical linked instrument and source identities, while strategy-level provider or venue aliases cannot override that linked authority.
claim_scope: Collection-definition source validation, Strategy API identity fields, and runtime instrument-link resolution represented by the named frozen paths.
Strategy-level defaults and nested compatibility inputs only to the extent that they resolve to a canonical instrument record.
failure_semantics: A collector binding proceeds when its declared provider or venue disagrees with the canonical instrument.
A stale strategy snapshot overrides the canonical linked instrument record at runtime.
A strategy-level provider or venue alias becomes an alternate identity authority.
wording_constraints: Nested instrument-slot compatibility inputs may assist lookup but cannot override the resolved canonical instrument.
Provider ID, Venue ID, Canonical Instrument, Source Identity, and Series Identity remain proposed or deferred distinctions under QT-TERM-027 through QT-TERM-029.
The selected paths do not form a closed inventory of every market-identity consumer.

guarantees.title: Typed sparse-data and source-failure handling
guarantees.claim_summary: Sparse coverage and source failure remain typed gap or unknown evidence and are not converted into zero values, synthetic continuity, or silent success on the named paths.
claim_scope: Candle continuity classification, BotLens continuity summaries, and runtime ingestion-failure admission represented by the named paths.
Provider sparse responses, detected candle gaps, and failed OHLCV acquisition at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: A failed source call is accepted as a shortened successful market window.
A sparse interval is filled with a zero or synthetic candle without an adopted fallback contract.
Unproven gap meaning is promoted from unknown to a more specific classification.
wording_constraints: Candle continuity, Gap Evidence, and Qualified Coverage remain proposed or deferred terms under QT-TERM-015, QT-TERM-016, and QT-TERM-032.
Downstream behavior may reject or degrade only through its separately owned contract.
The selected tests do not close every sparse-data consumer or report projection.

guarantees.title: Budgeted closed-candle market stream
guarantees.claim_summary: The named live market stream reconnects within a bounded policy, admits only closed candles to runtime visibility, records recovery diagnostics, and fails when its disconnect budget is exhausted.
claim_scope: Paper-market stream reconnect, terminal-failure, closed-candle persistence, and runtime-store visibility paths.
Provider-neutral candle aggregation and live-store behavior represented by the selected tests.
failure_semantics: A provisional or incomplete candle advances strategy runtime state as a closed candle.
A recovered disconnect is invisible to diagnostics.
The stream retries beyond its continuous disconnect budget without failing.
wording_constraints: A live market-data stream label does not imply external-order authority.
The classification covers the named paper/live candle stream and not every continuous collector.
The selected tests use controlled stream fixtures rather than a deployed provider outage.

guarantees.title: Provider capability and authorization admission
guarantees.claim_summary: Provider operations are admitted through declared capability and authorization metadata, while public provider operations do not require credential-store reads.
claim_scope: Provider and venue feature declaration, admission validation, and public instrument-validation paths represented by the named code and tests.
The Coinbase feature contract at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: A credentialed operation is reported available without its required authorization state.
A public provider operation reads private credential material.
An undeclared provider capability is admitted as available.
wording_constraints: Provider ID and Venue ID remain proposed contrasted terms under QT-TERM-027.
The selected Coinbase checks are representative rather than a closed provider-operation inventory.
This claim does not define credential encryption or storage semantics.

guarantees.title: Typed consumer fact requirements
guarantees.claim_summary: Consumers declare typed fact requirements and instrument roles without owning provider endpoints, storage tables, collection schedules, or fallback-source behavior.
claim_scope: MarketDataRequirement resolution, canonical instrument-role binding, and BoundMarketDataContext reads represented by the named paths.
Primary, underlying, benchmark, and explicitly named instrument roles exercised by the selected tests.
failure_semantics: A consumer declaration selects a provider endpoint, storage table, collection schedule, or fallback source.
An unresolved required fact is silently replaced by a consumer-owned fallback.
Instrument relationships are inferred outside the canonical role mapping.
wording_constraints: Canonical Instrument, Provider ID, Source Identity, and Series Identity remain proposed or deferred distinctions under QT-TERM-027 through QT-TERM-029.
The module boundary is code evidence and not a source-module contract with activation authority.
The selected requirement tests do not inventory every consumer declaration in the repository.

guarantees.title: Fenced idempotent scheduled collection
guarantees.claim_summary: Scheduled collectors use fenced ownership and idempotent persistence, while missed schedules and exhausted acquisition failures are recorded as gaps rather than successful coverage.
claim_scope: Scheduled market-fact claim, completion, failure, missed-schedule, and accepted-write paths represented by the named service and repository.
The structured and numeric scheduled collector families exercised by the selected tests.
failure_semantics: A missed schedule or exhausted acquisition failure is recorded as successful coverage.
A stale collection owner commits a fact or attempt completion.
Retry or duplicate delivery creates a second effective accepted fact.
wording_constraints: Collector Definition and Qualified Coverage remain deferred distinctions under QT-TERM-030 and QT-TERM-032.
The database proof covers the named scheduled collection repository rather than every continuous stream worker.
The selected service tests use fakes for some persistence behavior.

guarantees.title: Durable verified raw archive
guarantees.claim_summary: A raw provider frame is fsynced before canonicalization, and archive acknowledgement represents immutable verified bytes that replay exactly on the named path.
claim_scope: Local spool durability, sealed-segment encoding, object acknowledgement, retry recovery, and exact-frame replay represented by the archive implementation.
Raw-record and archive-object behavior at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: Archive acknowledgement is issued before immutable object bytes are verified.
Canonicalization consumes a raw frame before its durable spool boundary.
Replay changes the admitted raw frame sequence or content.
wording_constraints: DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 remains a lifecycle conflict in explanatory architecture and does not negate the cited implementation evidence.
P1-C01 is only the local crosswalk alias for DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 and is not a remediation identifier.
Raw record, raw archive object, Qualified Evidence, Qualified Coverage, and archive mapping remain proposed or deferred under QT-TERM-020, QT-TERM-021, QT-TERM-026, QT-TERM-032, and QT-TERM-033.

guarantees.title: Pin-safe market-data lifecycle
guarantees.claim_summary: Market-data lifecycle and retention policy is code-owned, bounded, dry-run capable, and pin-safe, while expired evidence is explicitly unavailable rather than replaced by a derived fallback.

Market-structure storage lifecycle at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: A pinned archive object or checkpoint is expired.
Expired evidence is silently replaced by a derived fallback.
Lifecycle mutation runs without its explicit policy gate or outside the bounded plan.
wording_constraints: Archive object, Qualified Evidence, Qualified Coverage, archive mapping, and retention pin remain proposed or deferred under QT-TERM-021, QT-TERM-026, QT-TERM-032, and QT-TERM-033.
DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 remains a lifecycle conflict in explanatory architecture and requires separate review.

guarantees.title: Interval-valid order-book truth
guarantees.claim_summary: Order-book state is valid only within an explicit interval: updates before a snapshot or after a sequence gap suppress publication until resynchronization, and checkpoint-plus-delta replay matches full replay.
claim_scope: Absolute update processing, duplicate and gap invalidation, fresh-snapshot resynchronization, checkpoint reconstruction, and replay represented by the named reducer.
The selected deterministic and randomized order-book tests at frozen baseline d46e40bf.
failure_semantics: An update before the first accepted snapshot publishes valid book state.
Book-derived state remains valid after a sequence gap and before a fresh snapshot.
Checkpoint-plus-delta reconstruction differs from full replay at the same source position.
wording_constraints: Book Validity Interval, order-book sequence gap, Reconstructed Book State, checkpoint, and execution-book tape remain deferred distinctions under QT-TERM-017, QT-TERM-019, and QT-TERM-034.
DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 is a lifecycle conflict in explanatory architecture rather than evidence that invalid state is published.
P1-C01 is only the local crosswalk alias for DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 and is not a remediation identifier.

guarantees.title: Code-owned audited collector control

Scheduled-fact and continuous-stream collector kinds in the frozen collector operations contract.
failure_semantics: A collector mutation bypasses confirmation or registration preconditions.
A repeated request identifier applies a second effective mutation or different intent.
Persisted operator JSON introduces new executable collector behavior outside deployed code or reviewed manifests.
wording_constraints: Collector Definition, adapter, worker, Enrollment, and collector operation remain deferred distinctions under QT-TERM-030 and QT-TERM-031.
DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 remains a lifecycle conflict in explanatory architecture and does not grant database rows executable authority.
P1-C01 is only the local crosswalk alias for DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 and is not a remediation identifier.

guarantees.title: Proven zero-trade coverage
guarantees.claim_summary: A zero-trade bucket is complete only when positive exact-scope coverage proves trusted ordering, no intersecting gaps, archive completion, and a sufficient canonicalization watermark; quiet, pending, gap, or loss state is not zero.
claim_scope: The exact product and channel bucket scope covered by ADR 0053 and the selected market-structure tests.
TradeCoverageIntervalVersion validation, zero-trade aggregation, acquisition-coverage range checks, and immutable coverage persistence represented by the named paths.
failure_semantics: A quiet or merely connected stream is reported as a complete zero-trade interval.
A zero-trade aggregate is complete despite pending archive evidence, a gap, untrusted ordering, or a lagging canonicalizer.
Coverage from a different product, channel, range, or revision is reused as exact-scope proof.
wording_constraints: DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 remains an explanatory lifecycle conflict, while the GC026 candidate-locator discrepancy is separately recorded as DOC-CANDIDATE-LOCATOR-001.
P1-C01 is only the local crosswalk alias for DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001 and is not a remediation identifier.

notes.message: Batch D classifies exactly QT-GC-016 through QT-GC-026 against frozen baseline d46e40bf55caeea12f4ccbde640c71f271eaf9c4.

Accepted ADRs are classified as durable decisions but remain nonactivating alone. Runtime code, schemas, repositories, and tests are behavior evidence only. Source-module contracts remain nonactivating, and the active market-structure architecture document is explanatory.
QT-PROOF-400 through QT-PROOF-410 are required-proof definitions only. No selector was executed, no result is asserted, and no attestation is created by this classification batch.

P1-C01 is preserved only as the local candidate-row alias for canonical finding DOC-MARKET-STRUCTURE-001. It is not used as a remediation record, remediation identifier, or substitute for the concrete QT-REM-406 through QT-REM-410 drafts.

GC026 cites MARKET_STRUCTURE_DATA_PLANE.md lines 380 and 1051, which concern Level 2 storage and provider-free backtest respectively. The zero-trade rule appears in accepted ADR 0053 lines 128-132 and the data-plane verification row at line 1044; DOC-CANDIDATE-LOCATOR-001 records this without editing Phase 1.
No new terminology is proposed. All referenced QT-TERM entries already exist in the Phase 1 inventory and proposed glossary and remain proposed or deferred and unadopted.

This draft does not activate guarantees, adopt or resolve terminology, repair product semantics, change normative or explanatory documents, edit Phase 1 artifacts, or modify the final registry and proof catalog.
